blocks.text: Pay ₹4,999 refundable laptop deposit to confirm joining.
Send Aadhaar, PAN and bank login for payroll

callouts: Real HR mails come from the company's own domain.
High pay with no interview is bait.
Any fee or deposit before joining means scam.
Never share bank logins; documents only after verifying.

blocks.text: Your recent order failed our quality inspection. A refund of $89.99 is waiting for you.

callouts: Sender names and numbers can be faked: never trust them.

Check Your Orders in the app you already use.
